name: How long does a bathroom tile installation take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom tile installation take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom tile installation typically takes between three to seven working days depending on the project scope. The process involves removing old tile or wallboard, inspecting and repairing framing or subfloors, installing waterproof backer board, setting the tile, allowing the mortar to cure for 24 hours, and then grouting and sealing. Custom mosaic layouts, complex niches, or full shower conversions take longer than straightforward floor retiling. HH Remodeling handles both the prep work and tile installation directly, ensuring mortar cures properly before applying grout or opening the space to foot traffic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most bathroom tile jobs take 3 to 7 working days, allowing adequate time for surface prep, waterproofing, tile setting, mortar curing, and final grouting.
